confirmedFacts.fact: Disposable ChatGPT OAuth with openai/gpt-5.6-sol returned the exact nonce and end_turn.
All RPCs returned end_turn; 3 runs retained only the second answer and 2 serialized both. Durable messages were 10 user and 7 finished assistant.
10/10 exact isolated answers; durable messages were 10 user and 10 finished assistant.
1.18.5 and 1.18.8 both coalesced concurrent prompts to the second prompt while both RPCs returned end_turn.
Immediate cancel failed 20/20; after generic update cancelled and reused 19/20; after provider acceptance cancelled and reused 20/20.
1.18.5 failed 10/10; 1.18.8 failed 9/10 and succeeded 1/10. Immediate cancellation is not a contract.
10/10 sessions resumed in a new process with an exact new prompt.
Each accepted request was observed once, transport closed, late write was rejected, and resume succeeded without automatic redispatch of the old request. SQLite retained an incomplete assistant row.

confirmedFacts.sample: 5 forced two-process races plus final validation

confirmedFacts.sample: real provider tool and attachment probes
confirmedFacts.fact: Direct external read was denied, but workspace symlinks exposed external reads, symlink and hardlink edits mutated external targets, and CLI --file attached an external absolute path.

confirmedFacts.sample: non-git, uncommitted git, and two distinct committed git repositories
confirmedFacts.fact: A known sessionId resumed from a different workspace; provider context contained the original user and assistant history. session/list did not expose it.
deny-all exposed none; read exposed read; edit exposed edit and write; write alone exposed none; read+edit+write exposed all three.
Configured max_lines=10 and max_bytes=200 were not enforced; 206 lines and 19490 bytes reached the model prompt.
A provider-started background process survived OpenCode termination in 9/9 runs until the supervisor explicitly killed it.
A fixed shared port produced exactly one failure in every pair; --port 0 produced 10/10 successes.

confirmedFacts.sample: 20 cold pairs, 50 warm list pairs, 20 warm ACP pairs
confirmedFacts.fact: Cold first-use failed one process in 8/20 pairs; warm list was 50/50 pairs successful and warm ACP writes were 40/40 processes successful.
At zero free bytes OpenCode failed on PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(PASSIVE); database integrity remained ok and the same profile recovered after space was released.

confirmedFacts.sample: header-only with WAL and full invalid database
confirmedFacts.fact: With WAL sidecars present, a header-only corruption did not prevent the next prompt; a 4096-byte invalid database failed closed. Restoring the authoritative copy recovered operation.
401 and malformed SSE failed after one request. 500 and pre/mid-stream disconnect retried three times within 15 seconds. 429 with Retry-After: 0 issued 66 to 133 requests before the outer timeout.

confirmedFacts.sample: real model switch and invalid variant probes
confirmedFacts.fact: ACP switched an active session from gpt-5.6-sol to gpt-5.6-terra. An arbitrary invalid variant string was accepted and persisted while inference succeeded.
Auto title made two provider requests per run; explicit title made one.

confirmedFacts.sample: cold and warm traced real runs
confirmedFacts.fact: Cold execution connected to npm registry and chatgpt.com; warm execution connected to chatgpt.com only.

confirmedFacts.sample: missing auth, invalid auth, unknown model, default plugin disabled
confirmedFacts.fact: All exited nonzero and no fallback inference was observed.

architectureInvariants: Bind cancel success to durable provider acceptance, not RPC send or generic session update.
Treat ACP terminal RPC as terminal state but not as an output-drain barrier.
Persist canonical streamed output outside OpenCode SQLite and reconcile incomplete provider effects by operation id.
Validate session ownership outside OpenCode before list, load, resume, prompt, cancel, or close.
Use isolated mutable HOME and XDG roots per runtime instance; serialize cold bootstrap and intentional shared-state writes.
Use OPENCODE_DISABLE_PROJECT_CONFIG plus external-skill disable flags and a clean HOME; --pure is insufficient isolation.
Reject or safely materialize symlinks, hardlinks, special files, traversal, and external attachments before launch.
Own a cgroup or equivalent process subtree and kill descendants on cancel, timeout, crash, and shutdown.
Use ACP --port 0 or an atomic port lease.
Pin and validate exact binary, model, mode, and variant; do not expose arbitrary set_config_option to tenants.
Enforce supervisor-side tool-output, retry, request-count, wall-clock, and egress budgets.
Use explicit title or disable the title agent to avoid hidden provider calls.
Manage OAuth generations with account binding and canonical CAS; file validity alone is not generation authority.
Classify storage errors independently from provider errors and restore state only from an authoritative verified copy.
